# Precision Teaching Study

Welcome to the Precision Teaching study website. This page includes the required activities for participants assigned to this study condition.

In this condition, you will complete weekly instructional videos, attend weekly live coaching sessions, complete frequency-building practice, and complete weekly quizzes.

## Study Timeline

| Week | Required Activities |
|---|---|
| Week 1 | Complete the pretest, Week 1 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 1 quiz |
| Week 2 | Complete the Week 2 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 2 quiz |
| Week 3 | Complete the Week 3 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 3 quiz |
| Week 4 | Complete the Week 4 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 4 quiz |
| Week 5 | Complete the Week 5 video, coaching session, frequency-building practice, posttest, and Week 5 quiz |

## Coaching Sessions

Please attend your weekly coaching session at your assigned time.

- [Weekly Coaching Zoom Link](#)

During coaching, you will complete frequency-building practice and apply the weekly content to SCC interpretation activities.

## Frequency-Building Practice

Frequency-building practice will occur during coaching sessions. Please bring any materials requested by the research team and be prepared to complete timed practice activities.

## FAQ

### Do I have guided notes?

No. This condition does not include guided notes.

### Do I need to answer embedded video questions?

No. This condition uses weekly instructional videos without embedded ASR questions.

### Do I need to attend coaching?

Yes. Weekly coaching sessions are part of this condition.

### What should I do if I cannot attend my coaching session?

Contact the research team as soon as possible.

### What should I do if a link does not work?

Contact the research team.
